description: Agent runtime composition root for Agentic OS
pre_install: Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.632.0/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne 'cca372e04171d5d1a1925478a3f4ba39ebbd180440445e6055c98d017ba31522') { throw 'aoscompose checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.632.0/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '348087efff80c64c45ba92942729f069270e84ac6d86667a3cfff0a961934108') { throw 'aosguard checksum mismatch' }
